source: live API at http://127.0.0.1:8000 (pristine datacharmer/test_db v1.0.7)
answer_format: numbers plain (no thousands separators, averages/percentages/ratios to 2 decimals); names 'First Last'; dates YYYY-MM-DD; booleans 'true'/'false'

categories.lookup: single-hop attribute of a named employee
categories.aggregate: server-side computed statistics and filtered counts
categories.boundary: strict-inequality and period-inclusive counting traps over populated boundaries — the naive inclusive or year-overflow filter provably differs
categories.exclusion: filtered count minus filtered count, incl. senior-title and decade complements
categories.disambiguation: attribute of the uniquely-qualified one among same-name employees (stated, entity-referenced, or double disambiguation)
categories.comparison: true/false comparison of two retrieved values (near-miss, strict-date boundaries)
categories.verification: yes/no state claims over history and tenure (near-miss)
categories.rank: n-th ranked positions, ranked exclusions, and top-n set logic
categories.nested: derived thresholds and dates chained into subsequent filters
categories.crosscompare: near-miss comparisons between two computed populations
